cpipe_instances.description: List of cpipe instances to configure. Each instance runs as a separate command pipeline with cpipe applied to stdin->stdout and stats printed to stderr. Every instance must specify at least a command; all other fields are optional and default to cpipe's defaults if omitted. Parameters not used in a particular instance should be omitted or set to false/0/empty string to suppress them in the rendered config line (cpipe ignores unused options gracefully, but best practice is to only emit active options). Each item is a flat object with the fields below.

prefix.description: Optional prefix string for each printed line (maps -p). Must be a simple string without newlines or shell metacharacters.

buffer_size.description: Buffer size in kilobytes (maps -b). Must be a positive integer ≥ 1.

speed_limit.description: Throughput speed limit in kilobytes per second (maps -s). Must be a positive double, or 0.0 to disable limiting.

non_greedy_read.description: Enable non-greedy read mode (maps -ngr). Use this for interactive pipes to avoid deadlock.

command.description: The shell command that feeds stdin to cpipe (e.g., 'tar cCf / - usr'). Required per instance. Must be a single command line suitable for a shell.
